ins.title: Instructions
ins.scaled: This test was shortened from {q} questions / {min} minutes to match the topics you have installed. Time was scaled in proportion.
ins.missing: {n} question(s) were removed from your content since this test was created and are skipped.
ins.rule1: The timer starts when you press Start. The test submits itself when time runs out.
ins.rule2: Answers are saved as you go. If you close the app, you can resume later; the timer pauses while you're away.
ins.rule3: Use “Mark for review” to come back to a question. Marked questions with an answer are graded.
ins.rule4: Answers and explanations are shown after you submit.
